name: Jose A. Lobato
bio: After spending ten years working on embedded systems, primarily using C++, I joined the Apple ecosystem in 2010. Since then, I have been focused on developing applications for iOS and macOS. Over the past decade, I have worked for various companies, including DxO in France, Teamwork in Ireland, and Kape Technologies. In each role, I have contributed to enhancing their architecture and advancing their projects to a higher level of maintainability.
